searchText: Do you get an error ? Thanks man, will try in a week yeah, times-out: "*Waiting for our turn failed (err: wrong or expired session-id, login again with the sequencer), retrying in 30s*". Tried a few times Get this error after a few hours of trying. Just kicked it off again now (13:00). Still running (16:15). Still running (19:15). Looks like this issue: https://github.com/jsign/go-kzg-ceremony-client/issues/6 If so it should also be fixed next week. I guess I got lucky when I tried the go client! Yep, we're waiting for the sequencer fix. Looks like that bug gets triggered on long waiting times. I also used this client (for obv reasons? ha) for my contribution and didn't get the problem. But it it was quite early and only had 2hs of waiting time. (thx for the support btw)
